intro: Dehradun is where MyUniMentor was founded and where most of our work happens — from free school seminars to the School Career Guidance Summit and one-on-one counselling.
local: Dehradun is home to many universities, so students here have more options than most — and more reason to choose carefully.

intro: Saharanpur is where MyUniMentor ran its very first seminar — at Brownwood Public School on 9 October 2026 — and where three of our partner schools are.
local: Students in Saharanpur are close to university hubs in Dehradun, Roorkee and the Delhi NCR, and we help them compare all of them clearly.

intro: Roorkee is one of the cities where we plan to bring school career guidance in 2027. Students in Roorkee can already book free one-on-one counselling with us today.
local: Roorkee is home to several universities in our network, so local students can explore strong options close to home.

intro: Rishikesh is one of the cities where we plan to bring school career guidance in 2027. Students in Rishikesh can already book free one-on-one counselling with us today.
local: Rishikesh is close to Dehradun's universities, and we help students and parents compare options across the region.
